text:
maria_cs: Hey team, just got an escalation from AcmeCorp. They upgraded to redwood-python 1.15.0 and now requests that used to return a partial response on client timeout are raising a PartialResponseError. User says this caused automated retries and double billing.

maria_cs: Repro they sent:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# previously this returned partial text, now raises
resp = c.completions.create(model='gpt-small', prompt='long prompt...', timeout=3)
print(resp.text)
```

maria_cs: Stack:
```text
redwood.errors.PartialResponseError: request aborted after timeout, no partial content returned
  File "/app/handler.py", line 42, in handle
    resp = client.completions.create(...)
```

dan_engineer: ack. thanks for flagging. Do we have a changelog entry for 1.15 that could cause this? @oleg_dev any idea? :thinking:

oleg_dev: yeah, 1.15 tightened behavior around timeouts. Previously SDK returned whatever bytes were streamed before the socket closed. We changed default to be strict and raise if the response didn't fully finish to avoid silent data corruption.

oleg_dev: That change was intentional (security/data-consistency) but I can see it breaks existing customer retry logic that assumed partials were safe.

maria_cs: Customer workflow: they do an optimistic parse of partial text and then ack. When they see exception the wrapper retried the call -> duplicate tokens charged. They need a quick mitigation.

infra_oncall: temporary mitigation: pin to 1.14.2. Also you can set the low-level flag to keep old behavior: ``client._config.allow_partial_on_timeout = True`` (internal flag). We'll document a safer public API before we ship patch.

dan_engineer: Do we want to publish a compatibility note and recommended pin? I can PR a support KB. Suggestion: pin to "redwood==1.14.2" and add try/except to avoid auto-retries until we patch.

maria_cs: Customer tried pinning to 1.14.2 and confirmed partial responses returned and no exception. They asked for an ETA on official fix or a public config option.

oleg_dev: Plan: revert to previous default for a minor release? Not ideal. Better: add explicit param on create say ``allow_partial_on_timeout=True`` and keep strict default. We'll ship 1.15.1 in 48 hours with that param so customers can opt in rather than pin. I'll open PR now.

maria_cs: Can we also expose a clear env var or client arg so customers don't need to touch _config? They want a supported way.

oleg_dev: Yes. public API will be: ``client = RedwoodClient(..., allow_partial_on_timeout=True)``. And we'll include note about billing risk in the docs.

infra_oncall: Also add a diagnostic header so we can track invocations that caused PartialResponseError: e.g., X-RWD-Partial-Err: 1 so support can map to billing spikes.

dan_engineer: Action items:
- oleg: PR for client flag + changelog + tests (48h)
- infra: add server-side header and billing tagging (72h)
- support: KB with workaround + pin instructions (now)

support-bot: Deploy note: staging release for 1.15.1 candidate will be created when PR merges, warn customers on support channel.

maria_cs: I'm sending AcmeCorp the pin workaround and ETA. Also asking if they want us to temporarily disable client-side retries in their infra to avoid duplicates.

maria_cs: quick KB snippet I'll add:
```md
Workaround (immediate): pin to redwood==1.14.2
Alternative (opt-in): upgrade to 1.15.1+ and initialize client with allow_partial_on_timeout=True
Recommendation: disable automatic retry on business-critical billing paths until 1.15.1 is deployed.
```

oleg_dev: FYI root cause summary for internal notes: change in timeout semantics in SDK 1.15 -> strict enforcement of complete stream; intended for data-consistency but caused behavioral regression with consumers relying on partial data and automatic retries.

maria_cs: Thanks — please keep me posted on the PR link and staging tag so I can share with the customer.

oleg_dev: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4281 (WIP). Will ping when CI green.

dan_engineer: thanks, team. I'll add the KB and notify Support lead.

maria_cs: closing loop with AcmeCorp, will escalate to CSM if they want assistance with disabling retries. :white_check_mark:
